name: comp-314
title: Alert Dialog With Icon
description: An outlined trigger button opens a centred alert with a circled warning icon, a short question, a line of explanation, and Cancel and Confirm actions.
use: Before a destructive or irreversible action, to ask for explicit confirmation.
avoid: The question, explanation and button labels are fixed in the file, so new copy needs a source edit.
a11y: The dialog primitive traps focus and Esc closes it, and the icon is hidden; the file itself ignores reduced motion. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Closed, it is a single outlined button. Open, a dark rounded panel floats over a dimmed page: a thin circle icon at the left of a bold Are you sure? heading, two grey text lines, a divider, then Cancel and a white Confirm at the lower right.
behaves: Clicking the trigger fades the panel in over a dimmed background. Cancel, Confirm or an outside click closes it with a short scale and fade.
customise: Title, description, trigger text and button labels are hardcoded; the component accepts no props.
weight: light: One trigger and one dialog; nothing runs until it opens.
demo: Trigger reads Alert dialog with icon; the panel asks Are you sure? about deleting the account.
polishWhy: Balanced dialog with a clear icon; styling is the stock primitive with no flourishes.
